Package com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.ott

Class OttRateLimiter

java.lang.Object
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.ott.OttRateLimiter
@Component @EnableConfigurationProperties(OttRateLimitProperties.class) public final class OttRateLimiter extends Object
Rate limiter of the one-time token endpoints, on the pattern of the account endpoints' limiter: Bucket4j token buckets in Caffeine caches (FixedWindowBuckets). Requests for a token (generation) and submissions of a token or code (verification) are limited separately, and each twice: per client address and per identifier (the user name the request names), so a single client cannot flood the mailboxes and the SMS budget, many clients cannot aim at one account, and a code cannot be guessed faster than the limits allow, on top of the attempt counter of the code itself. The identifier is limited whether or not it belongs to an account, so the limit never tells which ones exist.

Each bucket holds the limit of its key and is refilled all at once every OttRateLimitProperties.window(). The buckets live in this instance only: several instances each apply the limits on their own. The client address is request.getRemoteAddr(), so behind a proxy server.forward-headers-strategy must be set for it to be the real client.
